en: A vintage black-and-white photographic postcard showing a steep rocky hillside with bare trees and stone retaining walls on the left, and old stone or brick rooftops and chimneys of town buildings on the right. The composition looks up toward the Schlossberg hill above the historic town. Printed German text appears in a decorative serif font beneath the image, with a publisher credit and date.
